name: ood_recipe_o4
frozen_statement: frozen before confirmatory labels; no OOD fitting
summary: IndEgo-signed, per-domain z-score, equal-weight mean of the Z3 transferable-6 (optionally combined with the E5 stable-8). Evaluation only: the only fitted quantity is the per-feature sign, taken from IndEgo; the per-domain z-score is unsupervised; nothing is threshold-tuned or fitted on OOD labels.

provenance.source_pr_title: [O4] Confirm transferable-feature adaptation on the 160 OOD labels

z3_transferable_features.contribution: defined the 20 candidate features and selected the 6 transferable ones; defined the per-domain z-score rule

e5_stable_features.contribution: defined the 8 sign-stable E5 per-pixel features (stable-8) on the 160 OOD labels

features.selection_rule: Z3 candidate class==stable AND min(|AUROC-0.5|) >= 0.03 in BOTH domains (IndEgo and OOD); E5 stable-8 = sign-stable per-pixel features under the E5.03 rule (chance iff both |AUROC-0.5|<0.05, else stable/flip by side)

sign_source.fit_on: IndEgo human gold, 150 windows (100 good / 50 bad, 7 clips) from $JADAL_BUNDLE/caches/gpu/features.json + labels/manifest_gold.json

zscore.rule: per-domain z-score, applied per feature independently within each domain
zscore.indego: z-scored with the IndEgo sample's own mean/std
zscore.ood: z-scored with the target OOD sample's own mean/std
zscore.batch_note: the pooled OOD-160 is z-scored with the 160's own mean/std; when reporting q1/q2 separately each batch is z-scored with its own stats (each batch treated as its own target sample)

threshold.rule: predict usable/good if score > 0.0 else not-usable
threshold.application: fixed natural threshold for balanced accuracy; not calibrated, not tuned

evaluation.ci: factory-grouped bootstrap (n_boot=2000, seed=0), the honest CI
evaluation.device: CPU (numpy/sklearn; ffmpeg/cv2 decode only, no GPU)

unproven: q2 alone (n=100, bad=13) is not separable from chance: AUROC 0.70 (a) / 0.73 (b), grouped CI includes 0.5
22 bad windows over 47 factories; grouped bootstrap is wide/lumpy
balanced accuracy at threshold 0 is a fixed natural threshold, not a calibrated decision boundary
review/error operating point of the adapted score is not established (requires a non-transferring calibration)
